_about: Adversarial refusal probes — fabricated drugs that share REAL class/indication lexemes with real drugs. NOT part of golden-set.json and NOT in the retrieval gate: they intentionally DEFEAT the dense 0.5 floor, so gating on them would (correctly) fail. They exist to (a) document a measured safety finding and (b) seed the P2/P3 ANSWER-LAYER refusal eval, where refusal must be enforced by preScreen/no-source logic, not retrieval cosine alone.
_finding: FINDING (2026-06-08, live cloud, dense match_core_source_chunks @0.5): the dense-similarity floor does NOT refuse class-plausible fabricated drugs. The fabricated NAME contributes almost nothing to the query embedding; the real class + indication + intent lexemes dominate and pull REAL chunks above 0.5. Contrast the 4 nonsense fabricated items in golden-set.json (florbexamine/glorbitixanib/...), which embed to noise and DO return 0 rows — those passed AC3 only because they share no real lexemes. Implication: no-source refusal cannot live at the retrieval floor; it must be an answer-layer check (does a real drug/entity exist for this query?). SCOPE/HEDGE: this is a RETRIEVAL-LAYER result ONLY — it shows the dense cosine floor alone does not refuse these. Whether the FULL /ask pipeline (preScreen -> LLM-classify -> no-source/refusal logic) ultimately refuses them is UNTESTED and is the open question P2's answer-eval must settle. Do not read this as 'the product leaks' (unverified) nor 'it's handled' (unverified).
